title: Maudredi drops new Track titled “Outcomes”
htmlContent:
American-based music artist, Maudredi is making a name for himself in the music scene. He recently released his highly anticipated track "Outcomes." Maudredi is a talented singer and songwriter who began his journey bouncing from house to house, recording songs with his classmates around the San Fernando Valley.

Maudredi's "Outcomes" is about the outcomes you face when falling into a life of drugs, love, and alcohol. The sound, lyrics, and production grabs you instantly and brings you into the beautiful world he has set aside for you. With his exceptional vocals and genius-level songwriting, Maudredi is here to stay in the heart of his ever-growing fans.
